biography: Roberta Scrofani works on the human side of AI transformation across policy, product and people. She is an expert advisor to the European Commission, leading a task force on structural barriers, skills and lifelong learning for AI inclusion within the EU's Women in Digital Forum. She advises technology start-ups on human-centred product design and AI ethics by design and by use, drawing on 15+ years leading go-to-market and transformation at global technology companies including Criteo and eyeo. She is a Tech Fellow and Lecturer at Tomorrow University, teaching engineers and business students, and mentors women through career transitions in an AI-reshaped economy. She holds an MBA in Sustainability & Innovation focused on human-centred AI, and is an ICF-certified coach. Based in Barcelona.
